channel.title: Personal Ledger
channel.description: Updates for Personal Ledger on Windows.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.4

  • Edit a posted journal entry: open it and choose Edit. It keeps its number, and the change is recorded in the activity log.
  • Delete a journal entry you no longer need. An entry and its reversal are deleted together. Entries in a locked period can't be edited or deleted.
  • Save a journal entry as a draft and finish it later. Your drafts wait under Drafts in Journal entries.
  • Compare your balance sheet with one from a spreadsheet (.xlsx or .csv): see which lines match, which differ and by how much, and what's only in one of them.
  • Buttons at the bottom of windows no longer get cut off when space is tight.
